title: ALMA Reveals Sequential High-mass Star Formation in the G9.62+0.19 Complex
question: Does stellar feedback from evolved Hii regions trigger or shape sequential high-mass star formation in the adjacent G9.62 clump, based on its cores, outflows and fragmentation?

data.sensitivity: continuum 1 sigma 0.8 mJy; lines ~10 mJy/beam per 0.16 km/s channel

what.value: Herschel band flux densities of the clump

evidence.quote: The flux densities of the G9.62 clump at Herschel bands were determined by (cite: moli16).
The flux density at SEST/SIMBA 1.2 mm was determined by (cite: fau04) from 2-D Gaussian fit.
(cite: gern14) found that the median SiO abundances in HMPOs and hot cores are 1.4$\times10^{-10}$ (for T=30 K) and 2.1$\times10^{-10}$ (for T=40 K)

what.value: Ionized gas density 1.6e3 cm-3 and Te 10000 K for source B

evidence.quote: We adopt the electron density n$_{e}$ of 1.6$\times10^{3}$ cm$^{-3}$ and an electron temperature T$_{e}$ of 10000 K (cite: gar93).

what.value: CO optical-depth correction factors 9, 5, 2 for mass, momentum, energy

evidence.quote: were underestimated by factors of about 9, 5, and 2, respectively, if assuming optically thin emission (cite: Zhang16)

recipe.method: Identify cores above 5 sigma in 1.3 mm map; 2-D Gaussian fits (Gaussian plus point source for MM4, MM6, MM8, MM11)
Single-temperature modified blackbody SED fit of clump; core masses from dust emission at assumed Td
key_parameters: Td=35 K, beta=1.5 from SED; 100 K for MM4/7/8/11; 20 K for starless candidates
assumptions: gas-to-dust 100, kappa0=0.01 cm2/g at 230 GHz (Ossenkopf & Henning 1994), mu=2.37

recipe.method: Two-Gaussian fit to JCMT C18O(3-2) spectrum; virial mass M=210 R dV^2

recipe.goal: Outflow mass, momentum, energy and accretion rates
recipe.method: Per-channel optically thin masses from SiO and CO; inclination corrections; accretion rate from outflow force
assumptions: Vw~500 km/s, Mw/Macc~0.1, fent=0.25; SiO abundance enhanced x10 (MM7/MM8) and x40 (MM6); CO opacity correction from HH 46/47

recipe.method: Compare observed core mass and spacing with thermal/turbulent Jeans and cylindrical fragmentation predictions; compare molecular and ionized gas pressure
key_parameters: T=35 K, n=9.1e4 cm-3; turbulent case Teff~670 K

recipe.method: Per-channel outflow mass vs velocity fit with linear or broken power laws, slopes and break velocities tabulated

evidence.quote: The continuum image reaches a 1$\sigma$ rms noise of 0.8 mJy
We identified 12 dense cores above 5 $\sigma$ signal level
The core masses range from 4 to 87 M$_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$ with a median value of $\sim$20 M$_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$.
a total dust and gas mass of 2800$\pm$200 M$_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$
a dust temperature of $35\pm1$ K and a dust opacity index ($\beta$) of 1.5$\pm$0.1

evidence.loc: 4.2.1 JCMT C18O (3-2) line and virial analysis
evidence.quote: The total virial mass of the G9.62 clump is $\sim1200\pm180$ M$_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$

answer_key.quantity: Mass accretion rates MM6, MM7/G, MM8/F

evidence.quote: The total mass accretion rates for MM6, MM7/G, MM8/F are about 3.9$\times10^{-4}$, 5.7$\times10^{-5}$ and 2.2$\times10^{-3}$ M$_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$ yr$^{-1}$.
we can derive a dynamic timescale of $t_{dyn}=\frac{L}{V_{char}}=8.5\times10^{3}$ yr

evidence.loc: 4.4 Comparison with other high-mass star forming clumps
evidence.quote: The gas depletion time ($\tau_{dep}$) is $\tau_{dep}=\frac{M_{clump}}{\dot{M_{*}}}=11\pm1$ Myr

answer_key.quantity: Thermal Jeans core mass and spacing

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version and tclean/clean parameters (weighting, robust, cell, image size, deconvolver, masks)
Line-free channels used for continuum and continuum subtraction method
Velocity ranges integrated for outflow lobes and noise clipping
Dust-mass equations A1-A2 for cores and how flux used
Fitting method for mass-velocity broken power laws
missing_for_reproduction: Equations A1-A2 core-mass derivation details and line-free channels
Integration velocity ranges for outflow lobes
score_reason: ALMA data public and many analysis numbers given, but imaging/CASA parameters and outflow integration ranges are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data; core catalog and outflow parameters are numeric and checkable, though imaging details are missing.
